brief.summary: 3-step onboarding carousel for new travelers: step indicator dots, illustration area, headline, short body copy, Next/Skip actions

components_invented_or_custom.name: Step indicator (dots + 'n of 3' label)
components_invented_or_custom.reason: Compass has no stepper/pagination-dots component; built from plain buttons and spans

components_invented_or_custom.name: Carousel container / card shell
components_invented_or_custom.reason: CCarousel is not recreated in the bound design system; single-step state machine built instead

components_invented_or_custom.name: Illustration area
components_invented_or_custom.reason: No illustration set in Compass; uses Compass line icons (pin-on-map, calendar-check, tickets) on a surface-secondary tile

deviations.what: Dot sizes (8px / 24px pill), 44px hit-area wrappers, 112px icon size, card padding and some gaps use hard-coded px
deviations.why: No matching spacing or size tokens used

deviations.what: Illustration icons render in their default dark color, not the interactive-primary blue
deviations.why: The CSS-mask recolor approach failed (CORS on the serve origin); ignores currentColor

deviations.what: Marketing-style copy ('Your next adventure starts here', etc.)
deviations.why: User asked for more eye-catching copy; Compass voice is plain and factual

deviations.what: Icons copied into local assets/icons/ instead of loaded through CIcon
deviations.why: The CIcon component resolved to a path that doesn't exist in this project

deviations.what: Skip is a CButton text variant, which renders underlined

scenarios_considered: last step hides Skip and relabels Next
tap target size (44px for dots and Skip)
screen reader labelling (region, group, aria-current, aria-live)
scenarios_explicitly_skipped: reduced-motion (dot width transition is not gated)
real illustration artwork (icons used as placeholder)

accessibility.aria_notes: Container has role=region and aria-roledescription=carousel. Dots are buttons with aria-label 'Go to step N' and aria-current=step. The dots group is labelled 'Step N of 3'. Text block uses aria-live=polite. Illustration is aria-hidden. Contrast and keyboard behaviour were not explicitly measured; only token-based colors were used. Next/Get started hold keyboard focus via the native button.

history.change: Initial build: card with CButton Next/Skip, dots, dashed placeholder, headline and body; hard-coded hex colors and px type sizes
Fixed verifier findings: swapped hex for Compass color tokens, applied .t-* type classes, made Next full-width
Step indicator moved to the top with an 'n of 3' label (user request)
Dots and Skip enlarged to 44px hit areas (verifier); first attempt distorted the dots
Dots restored to circles plus a pill, with a separate 44px hit-area wrapper; placeholder replaced with an icon (user request)
Icon fixed over three attempts (CIcon path, CSS mask, then plain with static per-step sources); icons render but are not recolored
Copy rewritten to be more engaging (user request)
